console_theme_mode.label: Theme application mode
console_theme_mode.description: Global uses presets and derived shell. Advanced uses per-component overrides only.

console_color_preset.label: Color preset
console_color_preset.description: Curated accent palettes for the admin console. Choose Custom to use your own brand color.

console_brand_primary.label: Primary brand color
console_brand_primary.description: Main accent for buttons, links, and focus rings in the admin console.

console_sidebar_accent.label: Sidebar accent
console_sidebar_accent.description: Optional sidebar highlight; reserved for future sidebar theming.

console_surface_style.label: Surface style
console_surface_style.description: Flat panels or frosted glass surfaces across the console.

console_glass_gradient_preset.label: Glass gradient preset
console_glass_gradient_preset.description: Background gradient when surface style is glass.

console_glass_gradient_color.label: Glass gradient color
console_glass_gradient_color.description: Accent color for custom glass gradient (defaults to brand primary).

console_glass_gradient_intensity.label: Glass gradient intensity
console_glass_gradient_intensity.description: Strength and spread of the glass background glow.

console_glass_gradient_angle.label: Glass gradient angle
console_glass_gradient_angle.description: Direction of the custom glass gradient (degrees).

console_brand_primary_dark.label: Primary brand color (Dark Mode)
console_brand_primary_dark.description: Accent color specifically for dark mode pages.

console_sidebar_style.label: Sidebar style
console_sidebar_style.description: Background style for the left navigation sidebar.

console_navbar_style.label: Navbar style
console_navbar_style.description: Background style for the top sticky navbar.

console_popper_opacity.label: Popper overlay opacity
console_popper_opacity.description: Transparency layer for dropdown menus, select listbox, and dialog overlays.

app_logo_compact.label: App Logo Compact (Icon)
app_logo_compact.description: Square brand icon shown when sidebar is collapsed.

console_font_primary.label: Primary Font Family
console_font_primary.description: Main font family for the user interface text and headings.

console_font_mono.label: Monospace Font Family
console_font_mono.description: Monospace font for technical logs, tables, and codes.

console_shadow_elevation.label: Shadow Elevation
console_shadow_elevation.description: Preset shadow elevation styles for cards, toolbars, and tiles.

console_border_style.label: Border Thickness
console_border_style.description: Card and boundary borders thickness level.

console_button_style.label: Button style
console_button_style.description: Default filled style for primary actions in advanced mode.

console_card_style.label: Card style
console_card_style.description: Shadow and border treatment for panels, cards, and tiles.

console_icon_weight.label: Icon weight
console_icon_weight.description: Stroke weight for Lucide icons across the console.

app_favicon.label: Favicon
app_favicon.description: Browser tab icon for the admin console.
